newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Oct inflation seen 0.4 pct mth-on-mth.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Oct inflation seen 0.4 pct mth-on-mth.

text.p: Indonesia's October inflation is likely to be 0.4 percent month-on-month based on preliminary data, a senior government source said on Wednesday.
"Based on reports from the statistics bureau, inflation in October is likely to be 0.4 percent," the source said.
The source said the preliminary data indicated food prices dropped 0.04 percent, housing rose 0.50 percent, textiles rose 0.19 percent and services rose 0.98 percent during the month.
Indonesia's consumer price index declined 0.04 percent month-on-month in September, compared with a rise of 0.27 percent in August.
The government is expected to officially announce the inflation figures for October on November 6.
